notes: POC context: mid-market B2B product analytics SaaS embedding an in-app assistant and developer-facing code helper.
Trial key exerpts: 48h staging run - avg QPS ~58, 99th percentile short spikes to ~220 QPS for ~2-3 minutes, sustained peak windows (~15m) around 80-120 QPS during product demos.
Concurrency: typical steady-state concurrency ~10-18 workers; demo bursts up to ~45 concurrent connections.

Token mix observed: ~72% short interactions (user prompt 30-80 tokens, response 50-200 tokens), ~18% medium (prompt 100-300, response 300-800), ~10% long-generation/reranking and summarization (response 800-1,500 tokens). Embedding calls are ~8% of total API calls but account for ~30% of token volume due to batched contexts.
Customer ask: concrete Dedicated sizing (GPU count, instance types), expected QPS headroom, autoscale/burst policy, and deterministic tail-latency SLAs.

Cost sensitivity: mid-market buyer, wants predictable monthly commit. Interested in unit-cost tradeoffs: batching vs latency, quantized model variants, and fallbacks to cheaper models for non-critical routes.
Security: must support SSO (SAML), KMS integration for key wrapping, audit logs sent to Splunk, and data residency in us-east-1 for regulated customers.
Quote from Eng Lead Maya: 'We need a clear plan for handling our demo spikes without 5x over-provisioning — can we simulate realistic burst load with your runtime and show cost impact?'
Internal notes: SE Priya to run a Dedicated size simulation with 2 workload profiles (steady + demo burst) and deliver 3 pricing scenarios (conservative, balanced, aggressive).
Next actions listed in CRM: run 24h synthetic demo-burst sim; update capacity workbook; schedule finance pricing review; gather legal for SOC2 attestation docs.
requirements_summary: Evaluate Hosted API for development speed, then migrate to Dedicated for predictable throughput and isolation. Need Dedicated sizing that covers 99th percentile demo spikes (~220 QPS short bursts) while keeping committed capacity near sustained load (50-80 QPS) via autoscale and burst. Require SSO/SAML, KMS, audit log export, and regional residency (us-east-1). Interested in model routing: primary high-quality model for assist, fallback smaller model for cheap responses; embedding batching for nightly index updates.

dedicated_sizing_notes: Customer requested two Dedicated options: 1) baseline commit sized for sustained 60 QPS with autoscale to 120 QPS for short bursts; 2) higher-availability cluster with multi-AZ peering for 200 QPS sustained for heavy customers. SE suggested GPU mix: mix of A10G-equivalent instances for balanced throughput and 1-2 H100-style nodes for long-run heavy gen tasks; recommend KV cache enabled and prefix caching for frequent prompts.
